summary.name: TableTool
summary.one_liner: TableTool is a native macOS GUI app for quickly exploring, filtering, and querying CSV files.
use_cases: browse large CSV files on a Mac
filter CSV rows with multiple conditions
join several CSV files with SQL
summary.what_it_does: TableTool is a native CSV client that opens CSV files by drag and drop. The page says it can import a large CSV (around a GB) within a few seconds. It includes built-in advanced filters that combine multiple conditions and export the results. It also has a custom query feature where SQL can be used to join multiple CSV files. The page emphasizes speed and a lightweight footprint compared with Electron-based apps.
notable: Native app rather than Electron, marketed as lightweight and fast
Built-in SQL query to join multiple CSV files
Drag-and-drop import; page claims a GB-sized CSV imports in a few seconds
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether it is free or paid
